optimizedContext.value:
# SDK Composition

## Rules

- Package: `packages/sdk/`; workspace `sdk`. Runtime deps only `@specd/core`, `@specd/code-graph`; never CLI, MCP, plugins.
- Layers MAY include `composition`, `orchestration`, `presentation`, `shared`, `domain`. Domain only SDK errors/value contracts; no entities, ports, adapters. Shared internal/no subpath; named public-barrel exports allowed.
- `exports["."]` publishes `dist/index.js` + `dist/index.d.ts` from `src/index.ts`; `./ports` re-exports `@specd/core/ports`; `./extensions` re-exports `@specd/core/extensions`.
- Root barrel explicitly exports SDK composition, context/input/result/options; project status/index orchestration; Markdown presentation; `SDK_VERSION`; `codeGraphVersion`; `getCodeGraphVersion`.
- Explicit Core exports track public kernel surface: bootstrap, `Kernel`, kernel-equivalent `createX`/repository factories, use-case I/O, entities, errors, metadata materialize/read/regenerate/init, persisted schema/dependency/implementation/optimization use cases and factories.
- Never export dependency infrastructure/internal symbols, `SaveSpecMetadata`, `UpdateSpecMetadata`, `InvalidateSpecMetadata`, corresponding factories, or `PersistSpecMetadata`.
- Explicit Code Graph host exports: `runIsolatedGraphIndex` public contracts; `createGetGraphHealth` and I/O; `IndexResult`, `HotspotResult`, `ImpactResult`, `FileImpactResult`; `GraphSpecNotFoundError`; `SymbolKind`, `SearchOptions`, `HotspotOptions`, `RiskLevel`; `normalizeFileSelectorPath`; `createBootstrapGraphConfig`; fingerprint helpers.
- Never export graph lock APIs/path helpers/release callbacks/tokens or raw worker IPC. Hosts use isolated worker for writes; provider/use cases for reads.
- Export `buildImplementationReview`, I/O, and required public graph reference/logical-symbol/binding/member/coverage/health/resolver result types.
- Hosts combining Core+Graph depend/import only `@specd/sdk`; implementation-review hosts never compose packages independently. Core-only packages MAY use Core. Storage implementers MAY use Core or SDK ports/extensions.
- `SDK_VERSION` equals package version.

## Constraints

- Thin composition/orchestration layer; no duplicated bootstrap or infrastructure.
- Presentation performs no I/O.
- Root barrel curated; no wildcard Core export.
